blurb: Guests can book helicopter tours to see coastlines, mountains, cityscapes, and landmarks from the air. Tours range from short 6-minute flights to private 1-hour adventures. Charters are available for business travel, leisure, special events, and custom destinations.
extraNote: Flights operate in Visual Meteorological Conditions only (daytime, good visibility) · Flights may be delayed or cancelled due to weather · Off-airport landings require land-owner permission and may incur additional fees · 777 Aviation Drive, Camarillo, California 93010
